label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness) is a True Positive: java.util.Random.nextLong() generates cryptographically weak random numbers used directly to construct the rememberMeKey cookie/session attribute, enabling predictable session hijacking. Alert 2 (xss) is also a True Positive: user-provided cookie values flow into response.getWriter().println() without encoding, allowing XSS injection via the cookie name/value display. Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities on their respective paths.

evidence.note: Random.nextLong() feeds insecure token; user input flows to unsanitized response output
